author: Woodman36
quote: Very boring game, and does not feel like grand theft autos of the past whatsoever. Where you used to have freedom to do whatever, now you are forced to do chores that you could do in real life. The only positive about this game is the graphics, and I mean the ONLY. Its a terrible story gameplay feels sluggish and scripted. 13 years was hard to live up to the hype no matter what, but this has completely fallen flat on its face.
